about.text: A kind of Queso Campesino with a high content of salt in order to be kept longer fresh under salt water

sources.text: Colombian Caribbean coast; fresh, soft, heavily salted (0.6-7 %) rennet cheese, curd salted and heated, pressed; harder when saltier; not stored in brine
